texts.facts: 1 trial court were beyond his control and the applicant has every intention to appear before the Court concerned and participate in the trial.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is about 70 years of age and earlier he was granted bail by the competent Court on 20.02.2010 but due to some unavoidable circumstances he could not appear before the trial Court on subsequent dates. Hence non-bailable warrant has been issued. He submits the reasons on account of which the applicant failed to appear before the Moti Lal Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 25 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148817450/ Counsel for the applicant further submits that liberty may be accorded to the applicant for filing an application for recall of order issuing non-bailable warrant.
